results.title: WATERMARK
results.overview: Bu Rani, a geprek chicken stall owner with a traumatic past of being falsely accused, unknowingly receives a fake 100,000-Rupiah toy bill. When her son attempts to spend the money at a local store, a wave of paranoia triggers an absurd neighborhood raid led by an overzealous RT chief. In a community fractured by distrust and untraceable cash, digital payment becomes their ultimate watermark of truth and redemption.

results.title: VHS
results.overview: VIVA HORROR STORIES is a 3-in-1 horror anthology where every story has a secret, every secret has a price, and every nightmare leads to terror. A cheerleader is haunted by a sinister presence on campus; a seemingly perfect romance hides a horrifying secret; and a celebrity couple faces an unthinkable choice when their child is born disfigured. Three terrifying stories. Three unforgettable nightmares. One anthology that will make you scream

But the more Stan reveals, the darker and more disturbing his story becomes…  Hallucinations? Manipulation? Demonic presence?

results.overview: Tasked with organising a four-day stag weekend in Budapest, Daniel brings together groom-to-be Henry and 16 of his closest friends and family for a weekend of chaos, drinking and questionable decisions. But beyond the madness lies a portrait of Henry’s life, told through the people who know him best.
